notes:
TV improvements from testing on a real TV.

Sports is laid out in rows of tiles like the Google TV home screen: your teams' games, live scores and games from your interests each show both teams, the time or score, and where to watch.

The TV menu shows StreamMate's new logo. Home's channel tiles show artwork for the show that's on when the guide has none.

In the TV guide, Stop now stops what's playing and Red records the highlighted programme. Hold Back returns to full screen on Android 12 and earlier.

An update offered while Settings is open can now be installed with the remote.
